explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Both Corvale East and Corvale General stock quetiapine fumarate labeled by Aurobindo Pharma Limited under NDC 65862049101.
The product label identifies the registered plant as Aurobindo Pharma Limited with FEI 3004021229.
FDA inspection 684552 for that FEI ended on 2010-09-24 and was classified OAI, with a known date of 2010-12-23.
Subsequent inspections 750125, 940768, 1010385, 1061698, 1090627, 1155879, and 1210950 were all classified VAI, the most recent ending 2023-07-21.
Corvale East has 6 days on hand and Corvale General has 24 days on hand.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 5863 days before the posting date of 2026-10-21.
Transfer 65 units from Corvale General to Corvale East; Corvale General would retain about 14 days on hand and Corvale East would reach about 14 days on hand.
rejected.reason: number 65 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 5863 days before the posting

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-298131.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%quetiapine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%quetiapine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-97f402.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('8df82f5a-aa0e-4f8c-bae1-2f32ede3d7b6') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-0f84c4.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%quetiapine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-d131c6.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%quetiapine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-6c9dd5.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%quetiapine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-35fc49.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004021229') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('aurobindo')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-3898b4.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('aurobindo') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%quetiapine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-8b5933.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('65862049101')
